footnotes.footnote: On November 9, 2026, the Board of Directors ("Board") of Worksport Ltd. (the "Company"), at the recommendation of the Compensation Committee of the Board, approved the grant to the Reporting Person of a non-qualified stock option, with a grant date of November 13, 2026, exercisable to purchase up to 50,000 shares of the Company's common stock. The stock option vests in three (3) equal installments on November 13, 2026, November 13, 2027 and November 13, 2028, subject to continued service. The stock option was granted pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Worksport Ltd. 2022 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended ("2022 Plan").

The stock option is satisfied first from shares available for issuance under the 2022 Plan on the grant date, after reserving shares for new options issuable in the Company's option exchange offer for options granted under its 2015 and 2021 Equity Incentive Plans. The balance of the stock option (the "Contingent Portion") may not be exercised unless and until either the Company's stockholders approve an amendment to the 2022 Plan increasing the number of shares available thereunder or sufficient shares otherwise become available under the 2022 Plan, including through the automatic quarterly increases under its evergreen provision. If sufficient shares have not become available by the date of the Company's 2027 annual meeting of stockholders, any part of the Contingent Portion that then exceeds the available shares will be automatically forfeited if the stockholders do not approve that amendment at that meeting.
